batches._note: Batch composition for the August 2026 answer-production lane, added 2026-08-31. The G-series convention is that a batch manifest selects its action set through authorisation_batch_key = 'batches.<batch_id>', and oral_manifest.py asserts that shape. This lane had no such map, so batch H1 shipped with no key at all and its manifest audit was red - undetected, because H1 ran validate_corrections.py but never the manifest auditor. Rather than write a key pointing at nothing, the composition is recorded here where it is true and checkable.
